title: Server Monitor
description: ServerMonitor is a Minecraft server plugin that provides real-time system monitoring through in-game chat commands.

ServerMonitor - Professional Server Monitoring Plugin

ServerMonitor delivers comprehensive real-time monitoring for Paper-based Minecraft servers, giving administrators instant access to critical performance metrics through intuitive in-game commands. Optimized for Paper 1.21+ with modern Adventure API text components, it provides actionable insights without external tools or performance overhead.

Available Commands
/cpu - CPU load with core count and color indicators
/memory - RAM usage (allocated vs max) with percentage bars
/disk - Disk space (total/used/free) in GB with warnings
/tps - Current + average TPS (1m/5m/15m) trends
/ping - Player ping statistics overview
/online - Current online players by world
/uptime - Server uptime (days/hours/minutes)
/worlds - Active worlds and loaded status
/chunks - Total chunks currently loaded
/entities - Entities count by world/type
/players - Player distribution and locations
/ops - List all server operators
/setmaxplayers <number> - Adjust maximum players limit
/networkinfo - Network diagnostics and latency
/gc - Trigger garbage collection manually
/commands - Shows this complete command list
/help servermonitor - Plugin overview and permissions

Technical Specifications
API: Paper/Spigot 1.21.11+ with Adventure components

Permissions: Granular per-command (servermonitor.*) - LuckPerms compatible

Performance: Zero-config, lightweight, dynamic registration

Version: v1.0 by DORITOOO22
ServerMonitor equips admins with professional diagnostics for peak performance maintenance across competitive, survival, or high-traffic servers.
